claims.statement: For the matching-sector face poset obtained after stripping the two fixed vertices, Chong Theorems 1.2(i) and 2.1(iii)/(iv)(a) imply revlex minimization of the ordinary lower shadow. The matching-sector normalized-matching flow also concerns ordinary adjacent-rank covers. By themselves, these results contain no endpoint-specific hub-incidence data and establish no preservation or bound for the additional CB mixed boundary. In the stated three-vertex path model, revlex compression preserves ordinary shadow size but changes the auxiliary addability count from 1 to 0.
claims.scope: The unweighted matching-sector ordinary shadow and normalized matching property, plus the exact toy obstruction to automatic compression preservation of an endpoint-sensitive insertion count. The toy graph is not a full CB encoding or counterexample, and the claim does not decide the CB mixed inequality or the primary aggregate.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: The cited results and the path arithmetic check. Narrowed to say these abstract unweighted results alone supply no endpoint-specific incidence data or mixed-boundary conclusion; no conclusion about a special CB instance follows without a separate bridge.
